camel_example: aliyun cloudfw ModifyObjectGroupOperation --region cn-hangzhou --ObjectOperation ignore --ObjectType destinationDomain --ObjectList.1 '8.25.xxx.55' --Direction out
kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw modify-object-group-operation --object-operation ignore --object-type destinationDomain --direction out --object-list 8.25.xxx.55 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyObjectGroupOperation

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the requester
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response message. Valid values:
zh (default): Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
接收消息的语言类型。取值：
zh（默认）：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The operation to whitelist, remove from the whitelist, follow, or unfollow an object. Valid values:
subscribe: follow
unsubscribe: unfollow
ignore: add to the whitelist
cancelIgnore: remove from the whitelist
parameters.help_zh:
操作加白、取消加白或关注、取消关注。
取值：

subscribe：关注。
unsubscribe：取消关注。
ignore：加白。
cancelIgnore：取消加白
parameters.name: object_operation

parameters.help_en:
The type of the object to whitelist or follow for outbound connections. Valid values:
assetsIp: asset IP address
destinationIp: destination IP address
destinationPort: destination port
destinationDomain: destination domain name
parameters.help_zh:
外联加白或关注类型。

取值：

assetsIp：资产ip。
destinationIp：目的ip。
destinationPort：目的端口。
destinationDomain：目的域名
parameters.name: object_type

parameters.help_en:
The traffic direction controlled by the access control policy. Valid values:
in: inbound
out: outbound
parameters.help_zh:
安全访问控制策略管控的流量方向。

取值：

in：流量从外到内。
out：流量从内到外
parameters.name: direction

parameters.help_en: The list of objects to operate on
parameters.name: object_list
